summary.text: Michael Mickevicius, a U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 6th District to Debbie Dingell.
Michael Mickevicius received 0.3% of the vote to Debbie Dingell's 67.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2026
